READ: list_directory(".") returned only progress.jsonl; read_file("progress.jsonl") returned empty; list_directory("/") errored, so no repository source is readable from this session.
OBSERVED: no code, no configs, no earlier-round artefacts are readable; the only usable evidence is the round summary in the task text (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook = successor-weighted Frechet codebook updates; CURVCTRL-SID = per-RQ-level curvature set by hard prefix-transition score; LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ = Lorentz successor-profile smoothing; behcone-prefix-rq = behaviour cones; succboost-geoshift = behaviour-directed curved residual shift; BRad-RQ = behaviour rank/entropy sets the radial Poincare coordinate; BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ; MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ; TSG-SID). All of them measured math=NOT_RUN and none of them touched Stage3 recall > 0.065 in the record shown.
REASONING: the untouched part of the design space is the CHART/GAUGE in which residual quantization happens (a moving tangent frame), distinct from codebook update rules (round 1), per-level curvature fields (round 2), per-item radial coordinate (round 3), smoothing, cones and residual shifting. Nothing in the earlier list moves the origin of the tangent space at which log/exp and the residual chain are taken.
OPEN: write the one idea with the three switches, derivation of c, safeguards and a per-step cost at 24556 items / 24 steps / 3000 epochs.

STEP 2 (goal): fix the design decision and audit it against the scope contract and the experiment policy before writing it out.
READ: the scope contract (5 points), the experiment policy (one run, no ablation arm, no sweep, no seeds), and the earlier-round mechanism list recorded in STEP 1.
OBSERVED / DECIDED: idea = BATANCHOR-RQ, "behaviour-anchored tangent-chart residual quantization". The behaviour signal is the directed train-split transition table (top-K successors per item, K=8, weights = normalised transition counts). The curved operator is the Poincare log/exp map taken at a per-item anchor a_i = Lorentz weighted midrange of the decoded SID points of i's top-K successors, with fixed curvature c derived once from the measured median encoder norm (c = 1/(2*median||z||)^2), not tuned. The chart is the ONLY place the two meet: u_i = log^c_{a_i}(z_i) and the whole residual chain r_l = u_i - sum c_{l',k} plus the decode exp^c_{a_i}(sum c) lives in that chart; codebook update stays plain SGD/EMA inside the chart (so it is NOT the round-1 Frechet-codebook idea), curvature is not per level (not round 2), the radial coordinate of items is untouched (not round 3), no cones, no residual geoshift, no profile smoothing.
CONTRACT CHECK: (1) behaviour = directed transitions, computed from train split only, stated; (2) curved op = Poincare log/exp at a data-dependent base point, fixed negative curvature c, acting in the quantizer; (3) pathway: w_ij enters a_i, a_i enters the log map, the log map defines the code index, remove behaviour -> anchor becomes the behaviour-free global midrange, replace curvature -> logs become translations, either change alters code indices; (4) three switches named in code (use_behaviour_anchor, use_curvature, both on), observables = anchor dispersion, per-level code usage, first-level successor-transfer concentration on a held-out slice of TRAIN, Stage3 test_recall@10 > 0.065; (5) equations, inputs/outputs, safeguards, cost below.

STEP 3 (final answer, complete block): 
IDEA: BATANCHOR-RQ
TITLE: Behaviour-anchored tangent-chart residual quantization: the whole SID prefix chain is quantized in a Poincare tangent frame placed at each item's train-successor Lorentz midrange.
MOTIVATION: In a generative recommender the SID of item i is consumed as the thing to generate after a context ending in i. A Euclidean RQ-VAE spends its bits on item identity, so the deep prefix bits describe what i looks like, not where i leads. If the residual chain of i is quantized in the tangent frame centred on the region its train successors occupy, the prefix hierarchy is forced to resolve successor structure: level-1 bits are the coarse successor region, deeper bits the local successor shading.
NOVELTY: Earlier ideas here changed the codebook update rule (successor-weighted Frechet codebooks), a per-level curvature field driven by prefix-transition hardness, a per-item radial coordinate driven by context entropy, successor-profile smoothing, behaviour cones, or a behaviour-directed residual shift. None of them moves the BASE POINT of the chart in which log/exp and the residual chain are evaluated. BATANCHOR-RQ leaves the codebook update rule untouched and instead makes quantization non-stationary per item through a behaviour-weighted anchor point: an invariant/metric-chart (gauge) change, not a codebook, curvature-schedule, radius or residual-scaling change.
CHANGE: Replace r_1 = z_i by u_i = log^c_{a_i}(z_i), where a_i is the Lorentz weighted midrange of the current decoded SID points of item i's top-K train successors (weights = normalised directed transition counts), keep the residual chain Euclidean INSIDE that tangent space, and decode with exp^c_{a_i}; curvature c is fixed and derived from the measured median encoder norm.
SPECIFICATION: Poincare ball B_c^d, c = 1/(2*m)^2 with m = running median of ||z|| measured once at step 50 of epoch 1 (a measured quantity, not a hyperparameter). Conformal factor lambda_a = 2/(1 - c||a||^2). Möbius add oplus_c. log_a^c(y) = (2/(sqrt(c) lambda_a)) * artanh(sqrt(c)||(-a) oplus_c y||) * ((-a) oplus_c y)/||(-a) oplus_c y||; exp_a^c(v) = a oplus_c ( tanh(sqrt(c) lambda_a ||v||/2) * v/(sqrt(c)||v||) ). Behaviour table (train split only): S_i = top-K (K=8) target items j by count n_ij of j after i inside a train session window, w_ij = n_ij / sum_{j' in S_i} n_ij', floor 1e-3 renormalised; if S_i empty, S_i={i}, w=1. Anchor (stop-grad): a_i = pi( sum_{j in S_i} w_ij * H(detach( exp_0^c(sum_l c_{l,k_l(j)}) )) ), H(v) = ((1+c||v||^2)/(1-c||v||^2), 2v/(1-c||v||^2)), pi the inverse projection. Quantize: u_i = log^c_{a_i}(z_i); r_1 = u_i; for l=1..L: k_l = argmin_k ||r_l - c_{l,k}||_2^2, r_{l+1} = r_l - c_{l,k_l}; v_hat_i = exp^c_{a_i}(sum_l c_{l,k_l}). Loss = d_c(v_hat_i, z_i)^2 + sum_l ( ||sg[r_l] - c_{l,k_l}||^2 + beta ||r_l - sg[c_{l,k_l}]||^2 ) with the baseline beta; no extra loss term and no extra parameter. Whole 3000-epoch Stage 2 and the frozen Stage 3 protocol are otherwise unchanged.
COST: Precompute the successor table once (24556 items x window counts, top-8 kept): seconds, O(N * mean session length). Per step (B = 24556/24 = 1023 items, d = encoder width, K = 8, L = 3): 1023 anchors = 8184 hyperboloid lifts/rescalings (~5e5 flops), plus 1023*(1 log + 1 exp + 2 atanh/tanh vector ops) per level ~4e6 flops, i.e. well under 1% of a transformer step; wall clock +2-4% on Stage 2, +0 memory beyond B*K*d floats (~2 MB) for the detached decode cache

. No new parameters, no new sweepable constant (K=8 documented default, c derived, weights from counts).
HYPOTHESIS: Worth keeping iff directed train transitions are region-structured in the current SID space, i.e. the successor set of an item is concentrated enough that its Lorentz midrange is far from the behaviour-free global midrange. Then the deep prefix bits become successor-discriminative and Stage 3 test_recall@10 exceeds 0.065. Observed through: (i) per-item |a_i| dispersion and the fraction of items whose anchor is not the global midrange, (ii) per-level code usage entropy inside the chart, (iii) a train-held-out diagnostic: for a 5% slice of TRAIN sequences, the share of an item's transition mass that stays inside its own level-1 codeword (successor-transfer concentration), (iv) Stage 3 Recall@10.
RISKS: Successor sets may be diffuse, making a_i collapse to the global midrange and the mechanism degenerate to baseline (detectable in observable (i)); the stop-grad anchor may oscillate as the codebooks move and the decode changes every step; hyperbolic log/exp can saturate near the ball boundary and produce exploding tangents; reconstruction fidelity of item identity may drop enough to hurt generation even if transition structure improves; the Euclidean chart could simply be a translation that the codebooks absorb, so the curvature may turn out not to be load-bearing; K and the detach choice are the two places where a reviewer could ask for a sweep that the policy forbids.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: Directed item-to-item transitions (first-order successor counts) taken from training sequences only; no co-occurrence across sessions, no popularity normalisation in this idea.
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: One pass over the training split. For every ordered pair (i, j) with j occurring after i inside the same train session within a window of W subsequent positions (W = the baseline training window), increment n_ij. For each i keep the top-K = 8 j and the normalised weights w_ij (floor 1e-3, renormalised). Stored as two int/float arrays of size 24556 x 8. Never recomputed, never touched by validation or test data.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: The transition table, the anchors and the successor-transfer diagnostic are built exclusively from the training split; the diagnostic slice is a 5% hold-out of TRAIN sequences, not of validation or test. The curvature c is measured from encoder outputs on training batches. No validation or test interaction, no test-derived item, no validation-derived curvature or clipping statistic enters the SID construction; validation is read only by the frozen Stage 3 protocol after the single run.
HYPERBOLIC OPERATOR: Poincare log map and exp map at a data-dependent base point (a_i), with fixed negative curvature -c, c = 1/(2*m)^2 derived from the measured median encoder norm m (R = 1/sqrt(c) = 2m, so the median item sits at hyperbolic radius 1/2 and well inside the ball), plus the hyperboloid lift/rescale used for the Lorentz weighted midrange; hyperbolic reconstruction distance d_c.
HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: Inside the quantizer, at assignment and decoding, for every RQ level: the chart in which the residual chain is defined, the code index selection, and the reconstruction used by the Stage 2 loss. Not in a side loss.
COUPLING PATH: w_ij (behaviour) -> Lorentz weighted midrange a_i (curved operation on behaviour weights) -> u_i = log^c_{a_i}(z_i) -> residual chain -> argmin over codebooks -> SID prefix (k_1,...,k_L) -> reconstruction exp

^c_{a_i}(sum c) -> Stage 2 gradient -> Stage 3 prefix generation. Removing behaviour replaces a_i by the behaviour-free global midrange, which changes u_i, the code indices and the gradient; replacing the curvature replaces log/exp by identity translations, which changes u_i, the code indices and the reconstruction. Both enter the same single expression for the code index and the reconstruction.
COUPLING EQUATION: k_l = argmin_k || log^c_{a_i}(z_i) - sum_{l'<l} c_{l',k_{l'}} - c_{l,k} ||^2 with a_i = pi( sum_{j in S_i} w_ij * H( detach( exp_0^c( sum_l c_{l,k_l(j)} ) ) ) ), w_ij = n_ij / sum_{j' in S_i} n_ij'; reconstruction v_hat_i = exp^c_{a_i}( sum_l c_{l,k_l} ). The behaviour term is w_ij, the curved terms are log^c_{a_i}, exp^c_{a_i}, H, pi and d_c; both appear inside the same argmin.
OBSERVABLES: Anchor dispersion mean |a_i| and the fraction of items with a_i != a_global; number of distinct level-1 and level-2 codewords used and their usage entropy; successor-transfer concentration of the level-1 code on the 5% TRAIN hold-out slice; held-out train reconstruction d_c; gradient norms on the codebooks per level; Stage 3 test_recall@10 (the judgement) against the 0.065 target.
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: use_behaviour_anchor = False: a_i = pi( (1/|C|) * sum_{codepoints p in C} H(pi_current(p)) ), the behaviour-free global midrange of the current codebook decodes, identical for every item, curvature still on. Present and correct in code, not trained this round.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: use_curvature = False: replace log^c_{a_i}(y) by y - a_i, exp^c_{a_i}(v) by a_i + v, H and d_c by the Euclidean identity and squared L2, the same behaviour anchor otherwise. Present and correct in code, not trained this round.
ABLATION BOTH ON: the full BATANCHOR-RQ run: behaviour-weighted per-item Lorentz midrange anchor, Poincare log/exp chart at that anchor, the single 3000-epoch Stage 2 run followed by the frozen Stage 3 protocol.
SPEC EQUATIONS: c = 1/(2*m)^2, m = running median ||z_i|| at step 50 of epoch 1 (buffer, frozen after); lambda_a = 2/(1 - c||a||^2); log_a^c and exp_a^c as above (skip the vector term and return 0 when ||(-a) oplus_c y|| < 1e-12); w_ij = n_ij / sum_{S_i} n_ij'; a_i = pi( sum_j w_ij H(v_j) ), v_j = detach(exp_0^c(sum_l c_{l,k_l(j)})); u_i = log^c_{a_i}(z_i); r_1 = u_i; for l in 1..L: k_l = argmin_k ||r_l - c_{l,k}||^2 ; r_{l+1} = r_l - c_{l,k_l}; v_hat_i = exp^c_{a_i}(sum_l c_{l,k_l}); L = d_c(v_hat_i, z_i)^2 + sum_l (||sg[r_l] - c_{l,k_l}||^2 + beta||r_l - sg[c_{l,k_l}]||^2).
SPEC INPUTS OUTPUTS: Inputs: encoder embedding z_i for each item in the batch, the frozen successor table (S_i, n_ij), the current codebooks c_{l,k} (L levels), the curvature buffer c, the switches. Outputs: per-item anchor a_i, per-level code indices k_1..k_L (the SID), the decoded SID point v_hat_i, and the two loss components (no additional outputs, no additional parameters).
SAFEGUARDS: clamp ||z|| and ||a|| to R*(1-1e-5) before every log map; clamp the artanh argument to 1-1e-7 and the tanh argument to +-30; clip the output tangent norm to R (scale-relative bound, not a tuned constant); in the midrange, if the lifted weighted sum has Minkowski norm^2 <= 1/c + 1e-8, fall back to a_global for that item and set a flag counter; renormalise w to sum 1 and floor at 1e-3; anchor is always detached and clipped to norm <= 0.9R; empty successor set -> S_i={i}, w=1; if the successor decode cache is stale (nan/inf) fall back to detach(z_j); deterministic tie-break (l

owest codeword index) in argmin; a single nan/inf guard on the loss that aborts the anchor pathway to a_global rather than the run.
END IDEA

Goal: pick one distinct coupling position for this ideation round after seeing the rejected prior ideas (Poincare-Frechet successor codebook updates, per-level curvature controller from prefix hardness, behaviour-ranked radial assignment from context entropy, behaviour cones, successor-boost geometric residual shift, Lorentz successor-profile smoothing, branch-curvature MoEB). Read: task text only (no workspace write, no shell). Observation: all three selected/rejected mechanisms sat inside the quantizer's codebook update, curvature control or radial assignment/ranking. Reasoning: to stay distinct I move the coupling to a different computational object - the per-level *prefix code point* geometry - and make the behaviour signal enter as popularity-adjusted transition positives that shape every prefix level through a single geodesic contrastive objective (InfoNCE on composed prefix points at each level l), which is neither a codebook mean, nor a per-level curvature, nor an assignment weight, nor a residual shift. Derived constants only: temperature tau = 1/sqrt(c) (curvature length unit), coupling weight lambda_0 measured once at step 0 as stop_grad(L_rq(0)/L_beh(0)), negatives sampled proportional to popularity^0.75 (documented default). Open: write the full one-block answer with the three switch arms and the frozen-scale cost.
